init_BaseILTrainer: initialize a BaseILTrainer with a DictConfig to set up directories and flush settings
save_checkpoint: save a model state_dict as a checkpoint file in the configured checkpoint folder
set_flush_secs: set the tensorboard flush interval in seconds for the BaseILTrainer instance
make_dirs: create log, checkpoint, and results directories for the IL trainer based on config
eval_checkpoint: evaluate a single model checkpoint using a TensorboardWriter for logging metrics
